Great, Thank You

😎🌴

Sent from my iPhone

Hi Brett,

You're very welcome. Nothing more you need to do, your KBOX is first in line for the unit that landed at our US warehouse, and the tracking number comes to this address automatically the moment it leaves.

If you'd like to follow the stock side in the meantime, our shipment status page keeps track of batches on their way to us: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

And if you're not already there, you're welcome in our Discord for product news and hands-on help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Happy mining, Brett.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
